sn28.2:1.2: Venerable Ānanda saw Venerable Sāriputta and said to him:
sn28.2:1.3: “Reverend Sāriputta, your faculties are so very clear, and your complexion is pure and bright.
sn28.2:1.4: What meditation were you practicing today?”
sn28.2:2.1: “Reverend, as thinking and considering were stilled, I entered and dwelled in the second stage of meditation, which has the delight and contentment born of concentration, with internal clarity and poise, without thinking and considering.
sn28.2:2.2: But it didn’t occur to me:
sn28.2:2.3: ‘I am entering the second stage of meditation’ or ‘I have entered the second stage of meditation’ or ‘I am emerging from the second stage of meditation’.”
sn28.2:2.4: “That must be because Venerable Sāriputta has long ago totally eradicated I-making, mine-making, and the underlying tendency to conceit.
sn28.2:2.5: That’s why it didn’t occur to you:
sn28.2:2.6: ‘I am entering the second stage of meditation’ or ‘I have entered the second stage of meditation’ or ‘I am emerging from the second stage of meditation’.”
